note: Curated major wars and treaties in force on 1 January 2026, the campaign start. Region names refer to geoBoundaries ADM1 names in data/world.sqlite. The control and front lines are simplified to whole regions. This is a game starting point, not an authoritative account.

conflicts.name: Russo-Ukrainian War
conflicts.text: Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine, begun in February 2022, continues as a war of attrition along a front stretching from Kharkiv to Kherson, with long-range drone and missile strikes on both sides.

conflicts.name: Sudanese Civil War
conflicts.text: The war between the Sudanese Armed Forces and the Rapid Support Forces, begun in April 2023. The army retook Khartoum in 2025; the RSF holds Darfur after taking El Fasher, and fighting has shifted to Kordofan.

conflicts.name: Myanmar Civil War
conflicts.text: The armed resistance to the 2021 military coup, fought by People's Defence Forces and allied ethnic armed organisations against the junta, which lost large border areas in 2023-2024.

conflicts.name: Kivu Conflict
conflicts.text: The M23 rebellion in eastern Congo, which seized Goma and Bukavu in early 2025. A Washington-brokered DRC-Rwanda agreement and Doha talks have not ended the fighting.

commitments.name: North Atlantic Treaty Organization
commitments.text: Collective defence alliance; an armed attack on one member is considered an attack on all (Article 5).

commitments.name: European Union
commitments.text: Political and economic union with a single market, customs union and, for most members, the euro; includes a mutual assistance clause (Article 42.7).

commitments.name: Collective Security Treaty Organization
commitments.text: Russian-led military alliance; Armenia froze its participation in 2024.

commitments.name: Union State of Russia and Belarus
commitments.text: Supranational union with military integration; Russian tactical nuclear weapons are stationed in Belarus.

commitments.name: Shanghai Cooperation Organisation
commitments.text: Eurasian political, economic and security cooperation organisation.

commitments.name: AUKUS
commitments.text: Security partnership providing Australia with nuclear-powered submarines and advanced defence technology.

commitments.name: ANZUS Treaty
commitments.text: Pacific security treaty committing the parties to act against common dangers.

commitments.name: US-Japan Security Treaty
commitments.text: Treaty of Mutual Cooperation and Security; the United States defends Japan and maintains bases there.

commitments.name: US-ROK Mutual Defense Treaty
commitments.text: Mutual defence treaty; United States Forces Korea are stationed in South Korea.

commitments.name: US-Philippines Mutual Defense Treaty
commitments.text: Mutual defence treaty covering armed attacks in the Pacific, including the South China Sea.

commitments.name: Sino-North Korean Treaty of Friendship
commitments.text: Mutual Aid and Cooperation Friendship Treaty obliging each party to assist the other if attacked.

commitments.name: Russia-North Korea Comprehensive Strategic Partnership Treaty
commitments.text: Mutual assistance treaty; North Korean troops fought for Russia in Kursk Oblast.

commitments.name: Turkish protection of Northern Cyprus
commitments.text: Turkey is the only state recognising Northern Cyprus and garrisons it with a corps of roughly 30,000-40,000 troops under the 1960 Treaty of Guarantee as Turkey reads it; Cyprus and the EU call the deployment an occupation.

commitments.name: United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement
commitments.text: North American free trade agreement, due for joint review in 2026 amid US tariff disputes.

commitments.name: Mercosur
commitments.text: South American customs union; Venezuela remains suspended.

commitments.name: Washington Peace Agreement
commitments.text: US-brokered agreement between the DR Congo and Rwanda on respecting territorial integrity and ending support for armed groups.
